title: Range map equals list prefix
statement: Let $z$ be a finite Boolean word and let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $n\le |z|$. The list obtained by mapping each index $i=0,\ldots,n-1$ to the bit of $z$ at index $i$ (using false as the default value for an out-of-range index) is the prefix of $z$ of length $n$.
